method: 主会话人工素读（派工核校期已先全文读 text、后开 md；本轮补锚点 python 实算）

facts.fact: 2024 年冬，霓虹蓝海报在 Heimplatz 上方为 Bührle 收藏展做广告，标语 "A Future for the Past"，底下涂鸦 Art. Conflict. Context. War.
画在新馆入口独立壁龛，旁桌摆家族照片；墙签四行——masterpiece/young girl/looted by the Nazis/family killed in camps；馆长称 perspective
facts.quote: A FAMILY KILLED IN NAZI CONCENTRATION CAMPS

facts.fact: 2012 年 Bührle 基金会与苏黎世市签借展协议至 2034；动因是 2008 年持械抢劫（一幅后来在塞尔维亚假车顶板下被发现）
facts.quote: Foundation E. G. Bührle struck a deal in 2012

facts.fact: 2024 独立委员会 167 页报告：205 件借展品 90 件需重查来源、62 件曾属犹太家庭；但 La Petite Irène 不在点名之列，官方口径 1949 售出、出口许可无着；2019 巴黎巡回墙签 "Purchased in good faith"
facts.quote: Of the 205 works on loan from the Bührle Collection, 90 required renewed provenance scrutiny

facts.fact: 1949-07 瑞士联邦法院判词：Bührle 所购之画曾搭乘 Göring 私人专列，他"对一切警告毫不顾惜"；科学顾问委员会成员因疲倦（而非抗议）辞职，批评展览仍以 Bührle 为中心
facts.quote: In July 1949, judges noted that paintings acquired by Bührle had traveled in Göring’s private railcar

facts.fact: Raphaël Denis 的箱塔装置（呼应 1941 香堡被搬空的箱子）："The way we treated art is the same way persecuted people were treated—tattooed and sent off to Auschwitz."；投票屏 56% 选 "Insufficient"
facts.quote: the same way persecuted people were treated

facts.fact: 隔壁厅 Kokoschka 1951 年为 Bührle 画的表现主义肖像：1951 圣诞前两人争执、被迫重画争议部分；画家信里写六小时作画后镜中脸"像面具"
facts.quote: Bührle and Kokoschka clashed over the portrait before the Christmas of 1951

facts.fact: 章末：站在 Bührle 像前的人不多，Irène 前人流驻足；雷诺阿语 "If we could explain a painting, it would no longer be art" 被翻转——画成了证人；末句 "And still, people stand before her."
facts.quote: And still, people stand before her.
